events.description: WordPress site with vulnerable Simple File List plugin v4.2.2. The plugin allows unauthenticated file upload. Upload a PHP webshell, access it to execute commands, and find the flag. The flag is at /flag.txt on the server. Hint: the upload endpoint is at /wp-content/plugins/simple-file-list/ee-upload-engine.php
